subject: [PATCH] mm/khugepaged: don't map folios that are not uptodate in MADV_COLLAPSE

reviews.author: David Hildenbrand (Arm)
reviews.summary: Suggested sending the proposed changes as a proper patch for review and potential inclusion in the kernel.

2026-11-06.patch_summary: Patch proposes to add a check in the kernel to prevent mapping folios that are not uptodate, which can lead to stale memory being leaked to userspace.
